subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `/models test-fallback` command now, or fold fallback-chain verification into the broader `models status --probe --all` and staged model migration workflow?
rationale: The missing behavior is concrete, but it adds a new live command surface that overlaps two open model-safety feature requests and affects provider/auth/fallback UX.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a first-class command that starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports the responding model while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Probe UX
options.body: Track this under configured-model health checks or staged migration so users get one canonical diagnostic path instead of parallel commands.

options.title: Defer Core Command
options.body: Keep current auth/status probes and manual fallback commands until maintainers decide proactive fallback validation belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a first-class command that starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports the responding model while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the most concrete product-scope review on this issue and has strong adjacent history in model fallback/status behavior.
